visualMetaphor: a wellhead over a salt cavern, the tap on America's emergency oil
title: America's emergency oil, hidden in salt
angle: Trending T-01. The U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve is at its lowest since 1982 (EIA, week ending 9 Oct 2026) after releases since March during the Strait of Hormuz crisis. It exists because of the 1973 embargo: Ford signed the law in December 1975 for up to a billion barrels, the first Saudi crude arrived in July 1977, and today it is 61 salt caverns in Texas and Louisiana holding under a third of that billion.
